notes.title: COMPLETELY FREE FOR OUR PLAYERS
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41921751/0d79432f6c1eb534b0032aa953a7734669f82d9e.png"][/img][b]Universe Conflict Free Offer - Detailed Information [/b]  [b]Dear O.A.C - World Begins Players,[/b]  First of all, we would like to sincerely thank you for your amazing support! We want to take this gratitude one step further. As a special thank you to our existing [b]O.A.C World Begins[/b] players, we are offering the FPS game [b]Universe Conflict[/b] completely [b]FREE![/b]  [/p][h3][b]How to Claim Your Free Key for Universe Conflict:[/b][/h3][p]To claim your free [b]Universe Conflict key[/b], please follow the steps below:  [/p][h3][b]Prove That You Own O.A.C - World Begins:[/b][/h3][p]To prove that you own O.A.C World Begins, you will need to provide us with the following documents: [/p][olist][*][p] A screenshot from your Steam Library showing that O.A.C World Begins is in your library. [/p][/*][*][p] Your Steam Username. [/p][/*][*][p]Any screenshot from the O.A.C. [/p][/*][*][p] The purchase receipt for O.A.C - World Begins (Your Steam purchase receipt.)  Go to [b]Account > Purchase History > Click on the O.A.C World Begins purchase receipt[/b] and take a full-screen screenshot. [/p][/*][*][p] Include the invoice sent to your email by Steam.  [b]It's also a great opportunity for us to connect with our core community!  [/b][/p][/*][/olist][h3][b]Request Your Free Key:[/b][/h3][p]Send us an email with the information mentioned above to request your free [b]Universe Conflict[/b] key. You can send your email to the following address:  [/p][p][/p][p][url="https://contact@cotestudios.com"]contact@cotestudios.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p]  Please make sure to write “[b]Universe Conflict Free Key Request - O.A.C Owner[/b]” in the subject line of your email.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Key Delivery:[/b][/h3][p]Once we verify your information, we will send you your free Universe Conflict key as soon as possible.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]Who Is This Offer For?[/b][/h3][p]This offer is exclusively available for existing O.A.C World Begins players.  If you own O.A.C World Begins on Steam, this offer is valid for you![/p][p] [/p][h3][b]Who Is Not Eligible?[/b][/h3][p]This offer is not valid for players in the following situations: [/p][list][*][p] Players who do not own O.A.C World Begins, [/p][/*][*][p] Players who purchased O.A.C World Begins after the publication of this offer, [/p][/*][*][p] Players who have purchased O.A.C World Begins but have refunded it, [/p][/*][/list][p] These players will not be able to take advantage of this offer.  [b]Offer Validity Period This offer does not have a specific deadline. However, it is available to all players who have purchased O.A.C - World Begins by [/b]June 10th, 2025.    Thank you, and we look forward to seeing you in the gaming world!  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41921751/70f1242709f5dcb811e2f6d3debb219d5b8521ba.png"][/img][/p]
